text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Though Grass Wonder runs a<n>picture-perfect race,
it doesn't clear<n>her reputation as Maruzensky's
successor.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She sets her sights on a direct clash<n>with
Maruzensky to break free of the<n>association once
and for all.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But she needs to build up experience<n>in the
Classics first to make it a<n>reality. The Japanese
Derby becomes<n>our next goal.
